info.title: Messaging API
info.description:
Contacts, conversations, messages, broadcasts, automations and media for one workspace. No workspace ID appears in any URL: a workspace API key selects its own workspace, and a personal access token names it in the `X-Workspace` header.

A key or token acts as the person who created it, with that person's channels and role. When your plan doesn't include this API, every call except GET /account answers 403 with `code: plan_feature_missing` (see the `PlanFeatureMissing` schema).

domain.description: The domain you sign in to, without https://

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key (`Authorization: Bearer osk_...`), or a personal access token created with permissions, sent with `X-Workspace`.

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same key or token in the `x-api-key` header.

PlanFeatureMissing.description: Your plan doesn't include this feature. Every Messaging API call except GET /account answers this with `module: integrations.salesbot_api` when the plan doesn't include the Messaging API; creating, editing, approving or sending a broadcast answers it with `module: broadcasts` when the plan doesn't include broadcasts.

module.description: The plan feature that is missing.

message.description: A sentence you can show to a person.

reason.description:
Why the send was refused. Nothing was sent and nothing was recorded. The most common reasons:
- `active_contacts_limit`: the workspace is at its active contacts limit and the contact has not been active in the last 30 days.
- `blocked`, `opted_out`: the contact is blocked or opted out of messages.
- `marketing_opted_out`: the contact asked WhatsApp to stop marketing messages from this number (marketing templates only).
- `messaging_window`: the messaging window has closed. Send an approved WhatsApp template.
- `standing`: the workspace is not in good standing for this kind of send.
- `no_channel`, `no_account`, `channel_inactive`: there is no working channel to send through.
- `platform_unsupported`, `unsupported_send_type`: the channel cannot carry this message.
- `invalid_reply`: an empty message, an unknown or incomplete template, or a comment that is no longer available.
- `access_denied`: the person behind the key cannot reply on this conversation's channel.
- `already_attempted`: this send (the same idempotency key) was already made.

data.description: The recorded failed message, when the provider refused the send.

tags.name: Account
tags.description:
No workspace id appears in any /api/v1 URL. A workspace API key selects its own workspace; a personal access token names it in the `X-Workspace` header.

A workspace API key acts as the member who created it, and a personal access token acts as its owner. The API shows and changes only what that person could in the dashboard: a member limited to some channels sees only the contacts and conversations on those channels, a role that sees only its own assigned conversations sees only those in the conversation and message endpoints, and a role that hides phone numbers or email addresses gets them masked. A contact or conversation that person cannot see answers 404.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description: Read + activate/pause only. Authoring a node graph stays in the builder, which owns its own validation.

tags.name: Broadcasts
tags.description: The send pipeline is never invoked directly: marking a broadcast scheduled is what lets the sweep's single Scheduled→Sending claim keep it un-double-sendable.

tags.name: Channels
tags.description: Read-only: connecting a channel is an OAuth flow that happens in the dashboard. A whitelabel partner can also start one with the separate partner API; see [Channel Connect](/partner/channel-connect).

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description:
custom_fields is a flat {key: value} map. An empty map is returned as {} so client-side property access is always safe.

When the person behind the key has a role that hides phone numbers or email addresses, `phone`, `email` and the WhatsApp or SMS `handle` come back masked (for example `••••••••3456` and `j•••@example.com`), and searching with `q` matches those fields only by their whole value. Sending a masked value back in an update leaves the stored value unchanged.

tags.name: Conversations & Messages
tags.description: There is no Conversation model: a conversation is a Contact with messages, and the rollup fields are denormalised columns on it.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Upload requests are multipart, not JSON — do not set Content-Type: application/json on media.store.

tags.name: Segments
tags.description: Segments are the audience type broadcasts target.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Contacts are tagged by NAME (see contacts.tags.add), so tag names stay unique.

post.description:
Creates a campaign. Draft unless `schedule` is true. `timezone_mode: contact` sends the same wall-clock in each recipient's own timezone and requires `scheduled_local_at`. Set `type: retarget` with `source_broadcast_id` + `retarget_engagement` to re-message a prior broadcast's recipients instead of a segment. When link tracking is on for the workspace, links in message.text and in template parameters go out as short per-recipient tracked links. Tracking follows the workspace setting; `message.track_clicks` is ignored. A WhatsApp template broadcast respects the number’s Meta messaging limit: recipients over what the limit has left are held and sent in later waves, so a large broadcast can stay sending for more than a day.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:broadcasts:write`

post.description:
Creates a contact and fires contact.created. To make it reachable on WhatsApp, supply `channel` (one of the workspace's WhatsApp numbers), `phone` in international form and `opt_in_attested: true`, confirming the person agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from you; no other channel can be bound here. A number another contact already holds is refused. Subject to the workspace's plan contact cap. At the plan's total contacts limit the request is refused with 422 and an error on `name`. Contacts who have only commented publicly do not count toward the limit.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

Applies one action to up to 500 contacts: up to 50 inline, more queued (202, `queued: true`). Actions: delete, add_tag, remove_tag, set_stage. `value` is the tag NAME for add_tag/remove_tag and the stage id for set_stage. Per-contact webhooks still fire; contact-event automation triggers are suppressed so a bulk change cannot stampede the flow engine. `delete` also needs the key creator to hold the bulk-delete permission.

The unified inbox, newest activity first. A conversation IS a contact, so the id here is the contact id and can be passed straight back as `contact_id` when sending. Archived threads are excluded unless asked for. Each conversation also carries `source` (the first touch, e.g. `Messenger ad: 2021 Toyota Corolla LE`) and `referral`: the most recent ad or m.me / ig.me ref link the person arrived from, the same object as a message's `referral` (null when they never came from one).

get.description:
The thread, oldest first, paginated — so a client appends pages instead of reversing them. Each message carries `referral`: null unless it came from a Click-to-WhatsApp, Click-to-Messenger or Click-to-Instagram ad (or an m.me / ig.me ref link), and then the same keys on every channel: `source` (ad, post or link), `ad_id`, `ad_title`, `body`, `photo_url`, `video_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `source_url`, `post_id`, `product_id` (the catalog product the ad showed, for a catalog ad), `ref` and `ctwa_clid` (WhatsApp only). A key Meta did not send is null; media URLs are Meta CDN links and expire. When somebody who already has a Messenger or Instagram thread taps an ad, Meta sends no message, so an inbound line reading `Opened the chat from an ad` is recorded carrying the referral. Ad details are captured while click-to-message ad triggers are enabled for the workspace.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:conversations:read`

post.description:
Sends on the channel the customer last used (or the identity or channel uuid in `channel`), records it in the thread and fires the same message.* webhooks a dashboard reply does. Counted as a BOT send: it needs the workspace in good standing, never takes the conversation over, and gets the bot's messaging window. Refused with 422 (with a `reason`) when the contact is blocked or opted out, or the window is closed — send an approved template (`type: template`, `template_id`, `parameters`) to re-engage. A template with a copy-code button also needs `coupon_code`, the code the button copies (at most 15 characters). A limited-time offer template that shows a countdown needs when the offer ends, as `expiration_time_ms` (a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds, not a duration) or `offer_expires_at` (an ISO 8601 date and time) in the future. Without them the send is refused with 422 and nothing is sent; both are ignored for a template without them. Media (while inbox media is on) is sent by reference: `media.library` (an id from POST /media) or `media.source_message_id`; a URL is refused. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retried request one send.

The contact must be one the person behind the key can see, otherwise the request answers 404. A template sent without `channel` goes to the contact's WhatsApp, even when they last wrote on another channel. At the plan's active contacts limit, direct messages go only to contacts active in the last 30 days; anyone else is refused with `reason: active_contacts_limit`. Public comment replies (`kind: comment`) are not limited. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` after a successful send is refused with `reason: already_attempted`, so check the conversation before sending again.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:messages:send`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retried request a single send.

parameters.name: X-Workspace
parameters.description: The workspace UUID. Required with a personal access token. A workspace API key can leave it out; if sent, it must be the key's own workspace.

201.description: Sent and recorded. `data` is the message. A `delivery` field is present when the provider did not answer: the message may have arrived, and it is not retried.

404.description: No contact with this id that the person behind the key can see.

422.description: The send was refused before anything reached the provider (`message` and `reason`), the request failed validation (`message` and `errors`), or the provider refused it (`message`, with the failed message recorded in the thread and returned in `data`).

value.message: The workspace reached its active contacts limit, so messages can only go to contacts active in the last 30 days. Add a contacts pack for more.
WhatsApp's 24-hour messaging window has closed, so only an approved template may be sent.

type.description: What to send. `image`, `video`, `audio` and `file` need `media`; `template` needs `template_id`.

body.description: The message text, or the caption of a file.

kind.description: `dm` sends a direct message. `comment` replies publicly to one of the contact's comments. A template is always a direct message.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels. The contact must be known on it, otherwise the send is refused with `reason: no_channel`. Left out, the message goes on the channel the customer last wrote on, and a template goes to their WhatsApp.

template_id.description: An approved WhatsApp template. Templates are sent on WhatsApp only, and reach a contact whose messaging window has closed.

parameters.description: Values for the template's `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, … placeholders, in order.

coupon_code.description: For a template with a copy-code button: the code the button copies (Meta allows at most 15 characters).

expiration_time_ms.description: For a limited-time offer template with a countdown: when the offer ends, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

offer_expires_at.description: The same as `expiration_time_ms`, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

media.description: The file to send, by reference. A `url` is refused: upload the file with POST /media first. A channel that cannot carry the file type refuses the send with `reason: unsupported_send_type`.

library.description: A media library id, from POST /media or List media.

source_message_id.description: Send again an attachment of a message in this workspace.

source_media_index.description: Which attachment of `source_message_id` to send, counting from 0.

reply_to_id.description: Quote one of the contact's messages on the same channel. WhatsApp shows it as a reply. An id that matches nothing is ignored and the message goes out unquoted.

parent_id.description: For `kind: comment`: the comment to reply to. Left out, the reply goes to the contact's newest comment.

parameters.name: X-Workspace
parameters.description: The workspace UUID. Required with a personal access token. A workspace API key can leave it out; if sent, it must be the key's own workspace.

post.description:
Creates a tag, or returns the existing one with the same name (200 instead of 201).

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

parameters.name: X-Workspace
parameters.description: The workspace UUID. Required with a personal access token. A workspace API key can leave it out; if sent, it must be the key's own workspace.

get.description:
Returns a single tag by id.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:read`

parameters.name: X-Workspace
parameters.description: The workspace UUID. Required with a personal access token. A workspace API key can leave it out; if sent, it must be the key's own workspace.

put.description:
Renames or recolours a tag. `PATCH` works the same way.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`

parameters.name: X-Workspace
parameters.description: The workspace UUID. Required with a personal access token. A workspace API key can leave it out; if sent, it must be the key's own workspace.

delete.description:
Deletes a tag and detaches it from every contact. The built-in Unsubscribe tag is refused — it is the opt-out marker the broadcast pipeline filters on.

**Required permission:** `salesbot:contacts:write`
